primary_method_scopes.actual_optimizer_differentiation: Workers use SGD, not private Adam. The global map is a learned per-parameter MLP using moment/Ada features of averaged worker deltas (and optionally individual deltas). AppendixB explicitly names PES estimates for meta-gradients and AdamW for outer meta-optimization; no analytic native-Adam mixed derivative is established. AppendixA/Table3 explicitly makes moment-decay coefficients learnable during meta-optimization; accumulated state itself is tracked. The meta target is a trajectory loss, without establishing full-history automatic differentiation or native-Adam equivalence.
primary_method_scopes.deployment: Learned optimizer is applied to train optimizees; the algorithm produces centralized network weights. It does not specify a persistent adaptation-free four-head graph serving committee.
primary_method_scopes.persistent_reset_private_state: Algorithm1 supplies w0 and accumulator u0. Shared centralized update carries u across rounds; u contains m1/m2/m3, v, row/column accumulators and time. A persistent bank of private predictors is not specified. The scope does not specify complete accumulator initialization/reset across fresh optimizees or PES particle resets.

primary_method_scopes.actual_optimizer_differentiation: Direct gradient of pseudo-supervised contrastive query loss updates trainable encoder/projection head. EMA teacher/support embeddings are detached. No virtual private optimizer update is unfolded; selected implementation paragraph does not name or define optimizer moments.
primary_method_scopes.deployment: Discard EMA teacher; retain encoder; fit a linear classifier on labeled test support embeddings and evaluate test query nodes. This is support-conditioned test-time fitting, not fixed adaptation-free graph link serving.
primary_method_scopes.persistent_reset_private_state: Teacher encoder parameters persist by exponential moving average of trainable encoder parameters. Algorithm detaches lookup/support embeddings. No private inner learner bank or Adam moment/reset convention is specified.

primary_method_scopes.scoped_conclusion: Carried EMA teacher state stabilizes graph pseudo-task matching as a stated mechanism; it is not Adam-history memory or current-response meta-gradient evidence.
primary_method_scopes.support_query_construction: Three independently augmented graph views. Sample N query nodes, use teacher lookup embeddings to select top-k support embeddings from another teacher view, optimize query-view contrastive pseudo-label objective. Generic background says disjoint support/query, but actual top-k procedure does not explicitly exclude the same node or link endpoints. No training node labels are used.
